item.title: Getting Started
item.description:
This guide walks you through logging in to Haltian Finder and navigating the interface.

Login

  1. Open haltian-finder.eu.haltian.io in your browser
  2. Enter your credentials:
Field Description
Organization Your Haltian IoT organization name
Username Your email address
Password Your account password
  1. Click Sign In
Account Access

If you don’t have an account or have forgotten your password, contact your organization’s Manager.

App Layout

After login, the Haltian Finder interface has two main areas:

item.title: Device Search
item.description:
The main screen of Haltian Finder is the device search page. Type in the search field to find devices — the search looks across device names, identifiers, and keywords simultaneously.

How Search Works

Use the search field to find sensor devices and tags by name, identifier, or assigned keyword. Search is case-insensitive and begins automatically after you stop typing for one second.

The search matches across:

  • Device name — full or partial match
  • Device identifiers — Customer Label ID, GIAI, TUID, Wirepas Node ID, and serial number
  • Keywords — any keyword assigned to the device

item.title: Device Details
item.description:
When you open a device from search results or the recently viewed list, the device details view shows device information and an interactive location map.

Device Information (Left Panel)

The left side of the device details view displays:

Element Description
Device name The name assigned to the device
Close button Returns to the search page
Refresh button Reloads the device data
Keywords Keywords assigned to this device
Last seen When the device last communicated, shown as relative time (e.g. “2 hours ago”)
Device image Photo attached to the device, or a default icon for the device type

Location (Right Panel)

The right side shows the device’s location on an interactive map.

item.title: Profile & Settings
item.description:
Access your profile by clicking the profile icon in the top-right corner of the navigation bar.

Profile Information

The profile menu displays your account details:

Field Description
Organization Your organization name
Username Your login email
Role Your assigned role (Manager, Designer, Installer, or Viewer)
User UUID Your system identifier

Log Out

  1. Click the profile icon in the top-right corner
  2. Select Log out

Logging out clears your session and returns you to the login page.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Login Issues

Problem Solution
Can’t log in Verify your organization name, email, and password are correct. Check for typos and extra spaces.
“No site rights” error after login Your account does not have access to any sites. Contact your organization’s Manager to assign site access.
Forgot password Contact your organization’s Manager to reset your password.
Session expired Your login session has timed out. Sign in again with your credentials.

Search Issues

Problem Solution
No results found Check spelling. Try searching by a different identifier (device name, Customer Label ID, TUID, Wirepas Node ID).
Too many results (100+ warning) Refine your search terms to be more specific. Add more characters or use a unique identifier.
Search feels slow Search has a 1-second delay after typing to avoid unnecessary queries. Wait briefly for results to appear.

Device Details

Problem Solution
Map not loading Check your internet connection. Try refreshing the page. Ensure JavaScript is enabled in your browser.
Location not showing The device may not have position data. Not all device types support location tracking.
Position history empty Try a longer time range. The device may not have moved during the selected period.

Browser Issues

Problem Solution
Page not loading or blank screen Clear browser cache and cookies. Try a different browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
Layout looks broken Ensure you’re using a modern browser with the latest updates.
Recently viewed list empty Recently viewed devices are stored in your browser’s local storage. Clearing browser data resets this list.
